2025-06-27 official notice warned of remaining snow and difficult water crossings from Kilpisjärvi to Halti, valid to 2025-07-13; expired but relevant as seasonal risk.
2026-02-09 maintenance-track notice says the Kilpisjärvi-Halti twig-marked winter route is not maintained for skiers and has no condition guarantee.
2026-03-07 Luontoon avalanche notice warned of high Käsivarsi avalanche risk; winter/spring users must check live FMI avalanche forecast.
waterAndHealth: No maintained drinking-water point verified; natural waters should be boiled/treated and are used at hiker's own risk.

June-July 2025 stomach-flu/norovirus advisories affected Kalottireitti generally. The specific avoid-huts warning named Saarijärvi and Guonjarjohka, not section 4; 2025-07-08 notice said Kalottireitti was open for normal hiking again.
routeHazards: Field reports repeatedly describe rocky and slippery Meekonjärvi shore terrain and wet planks/boulders in rain/snow.
Vuomakasjoki bridge/railing currentness needs final official verification; E1 says the destroyed 2022 bridge has been replaced, while AllTrails carried an unresolved warning about broken railing.
OSM ford=yes nodes and field reports of detour fords should be treated as safety clues, not route geometry, until verified.
reindeerHerdingHuntingForestry: Käsivarsi is a reindeer-herding area; avoid disturbing reindeer and close gates unless intentionally left open.
Käsivarsi hunting area 1613 is relevant for seasonal hunting context.
currentness: Luontoon route page/API was flagged under construction with validity 2026-04-22 to 2026-05-30; recheck before normalization.
No official active closure specific to Meekonjärvi-Pitsusjärvi was found on 2026-04-29.

agents.summary: Confirmed official Reisa 12 km leg, Reisa poster 8.5 km contradiction, Luontoon route/API/Retkikartta route sources, endpoint hut coordinates, services, and no active official section closure found.
Measured Luontoon OGC line 14 at 10.331 km, OSM relation 9518223 at 10.293 km, and E1 GPX at 10.319 km; all reverse-direction relative to the target order and conflict with official 12 km.
Verified Meekonjärvi and Pitsusjärvi huts/toilets, Pitsusjärvi waste/recycling, Vuomakasjoki bridge, Pitsusköngäs pending viewpoint, woodshed caveats, and suppress/private/off-route items.

Confirmed both endpoints are wilderness-only, Kilpisjärvi is the standard scheduled access base, Guolasjávri is a conditional road alternative, and snowmobile sled transport is private seasonal logistics.

Collected 2016-2025 evidence for rocky/wet terrain, Meekonjärvi shore difficulty, Vuomakasjoki bridge/crossing currentness, Pitsusköngäs, hut crowding, snow and bad-weather risk, and 10.3-12 km distance claims.

Covered Käsivarsi rules, Ánnjaloanji caveat, Pitsusjärvi hut camping/fire/water/waste rules, dog/pet restrictions, reindeer/hunting context, winter/avalanche notices, snow/water seasonal risks, and health-currentness history.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Research is complete enough for candidate-file normalization review. Do not mark automated-import-ready until geometry is clipped/exported, the 12 km versus 10.3 km/8.5 km distance contradiction is accepted or explained, Vuomakasjoki bridge/railing currentness is rechecked, Meekonjärvi side-spur facilities are modeled, and Ánnjaloanji overlap is checked.
